title: Measure-valued free-energy minimizers for trapped bosons with repulsive Coulomb interaction
summary: We study a free-energy minimization problem for a trapped semiclassical Bose gas with repulsive Coulomb self-interaction. Because the bosonic entropy density has zero recession slope, the natural relaxation is posed over nonnegative finite Radon measures on phase space, and a minimizer may have a singular component. We interpret this component as condensation within the relaxed semiclassical model.
